name: Lurdusaurus (Coast)
label: Coast variant
title: Lavaschnauber
note: The coastal Lurdusaurus of the profile ("some even in coastal regions", "more blue, gray and white in their colors"): a marine iguana with a hippo's temper on the beaches, sea cliffs and islands (Tallbrush Coasts, Coastal Bluffs, Volcano Islands, Palm Islands). Grazes only kelp, snorts out salt, shelters from the sun by day and warms up on sun-heated rock at night. Shares the official Lurdusaurus profile with the freshwater variant.
